post.description:
Body: an AI SDK v5 chat request ({id, messages, trigger}); `run_id` in the body or the query
scopes the chat to one run.

200.description: Vercel AI SDK UI-message stream (x-vercel-ai-ui-message-stream: v1)

AnswerRow.title: AnswerRow
AnswerRow.description: A table row (`cells`) or a graph row (source, predicate, target, ...), with its facts.

AnswerShape.title: AnswerShape
AnswerShape.description: A table (columns) or a graph (node types and edge types): the brief's answer template.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: accepted: the exact text anchored in the corpus; rejected: the quote as sent

picked_by.title: Picked By
picked_by.description: user, claude or provisional-first (the pick record's)

support.description: the best verdict over the fact's quotes, or null

label.title: Label
label.description: the fact's support label as scoring defines it (best verdict over its claims; unsourced: no accepted claim; pending: a verdict is missing); null: nothing judged

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: the gold builder's stage (progress.json), when it wrote one

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: the gold builder's own stage (progress.json: starting, building, failed, writing, done), when it wrote one; `building` with stage done or failed and no job running means D is there but triage, pool or draft have not run

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: concepts, run or gold; one job of a kind runs at a time

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: optional steps that failed (the job can still be done)

command.title: Command
command.description: argv as one shell-quoted line, for reading

required.title: Required
required.description: a failure fails the job (an optional step's failure is a warning)

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: files the step needs; it is skipped when one is missing

text.title: Text
text.description: the window of the paper's text around the span

highlight.description: the span in `text`, in code points (Python, the anchors)

highlight_utf16.description: the same span in UTF-16 code units: text.slice(start, end) in JavaScript

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: raw offset of `text` in the paper file, in code points

length.title: Length
length.description: length of the whole paper file in code points

Passage.title: Passage
Passage.description:
Offsets count Unicode code points (Python's), as the agent's anchors do; JavaScript strings count
UTF-16 code units, which differ after any character outside the BMP (e.g. math italic letters in
a converted PDF), so the frontend slices `text` with `highlight_utf16`.

replaces_concept_sha256.title: Replaces Concept Sha256
replaces_concept_sha256.description: the concept this pick replaced, if it changed one

Pick.title: Pick
Pick.description: The current pick: the last `concept_pick` record of the session's hash chain.

force.title: Force
force.description: change the pick although runs use the current concept (they then show as concept_current false)

Results.title: Results
Results.description:
$RUNS/report/report.json (scoring, M4) as written: per question x condition means, paired
differences, intervals, Wilcoxon results and the pre-registered primary test.

qid.title: Qid
qid.description: question id; its picked concept ($CONCEPTS/<qid>/concept.json) is used

concept_path.title: Concept Path
concept_path.description: a concept.json under $CONCEPTS or $RUNS instead of a qid

attach.title: Attach
attach.description: claim_off: run the attach step after the run

force.title: Force
force.description: start although a run the web app did not start (a batch on the cluster) is live: both then share the orchestrator, which slows the batch runs and inflates their recorded time

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: the run directory's name, or <batch>~<name> for a run one level down ($RUNS/<batch>/<name>, e.g. m4-72~q01-claim_on-r1-a1, web~...)

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: the directory the run is in below $RUNS (a batch manifest's name, or `web` for runs the web app started)

concept_current.title: Concept Current
concept_current.description: the run used the question's current pick; false: a replaced or another concept (left out of the question's counts); null: the question has no pick

exit_status.title: Exit Status
exit_status.description: submitted, budget, context_full, error, cut, running, incomplete, or another exit status the harness recorded

answer_from.title: Answer From
answer_from.description: final: the model's final answer; draft: the agent's draft file, taken by the harness (answer_from_draft); none: the harness wrote an answer with no rows (no_final_answer); null: no answer yet or not recorded

verify_from.title: Verify From
verify_from.description: where `verify` comes from: the app's own `agent verify` (cached while the server runs), or score.json's verify_ok when the scorer checked the run after its last record

live.title: Live
live.description: the agent is still writing the run (research, or the attach step)

post_processing.title: Post Processing
post_processing.description: a web-app job still runs verify, pairs, graph, export-prov or score on the finished run

Score.title: Score
Score.description: `<run>/score.json` (scoring, M4); only the plan's top-level fields are typed.

key_version.title: Key Version
key_version.description: the answer key's version (v1, or v1-draft)

provisional.title: Provisional
provisional.description: scored against the draft key: tests the pipeline, never a result

boolean.title: Boolean
boolean.description: ASK queries: the answer (vars and rows are empty)

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: research, conclude, attach, ... (the model call's phase)

fact_id.title: Fact Id
fact_id.description: attach step: the answer fact this step works on

source.title: Source
source.description: score: the verdict score.json counted (the primary outcome's); judge: asked live (?judge=true) because the run has no scored verdict

claim.description: null when the id is not an accepted claim of this run

anchor_status.title: Anchor Status
anchor_status.description: ok, relocated, ambiguous, broken, or unknown (no corpus)
